summary_1line: Arjuna warns that war will consume the Kaurava allies, while Sanjaya tells Dhritarashtra that Krishna’s divine power ensures the Pandavas’ ultimate victory.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna, beside Krishna on the chariot, declares that the gathered kings will become libations in the blazing sacrificial fire of battle.
Sanjaya stands before the blind king Dhritarashtra in the royal court, describing Krishna whose divine presence outweighs the entire universe.
Krishna’s radiant discus Sudarshana, blazing with light and shifting size by his will, hovers invisibly above the battlefield.
